functions.name: promptCutsOf
functions.summary: Returns a request's valid split points, or none to send it whole.
functions.change: Adds the safety check for splitting a prompt: if any split point is invalid, for example one leaving a blank piece, the prompt is sent whole, same text.

functions.name: promptPartsOf
functions.summary: Splits a prompt at its split points into pieces that rejoin exactly.
functions.change: Adds the split itself: the prompt becomes a list of pieces that join back to the original text in order, so the model reads exactly the same words.

functions.name: appendedRequest
functions.summary: Builds a follow-up request: the original prompt plus added text.
functions.change: Adds the helper for asking again: the follow-up keeps the original's split points plus one where the original ended, so the repeated original is read from cache.

functions.name: continuedRequest
functions.summary: Splits a rebuilt repair at the original's end, if it extends it.
functions.change: Adds the same reuse for repairs built from scratch: split at the original's end only when the new prompt starts with the original exactly; otherwise left as it was.

functions.name: staggerSharedParts
functions.summary: Holds back requests sharing an opening until the first one's reply starts.
functions.change: Adds a queue: requests sharing a long opening wait until the first one's reply begins or its call ends, then read that opening from cache instead of rewriting it.

functions.name: sharedFirstOf
functions.summary: Fingerprints a request's instructions, answer format and opening, to group requests.
functions.change: Adds the grouping rule: requests share a group only when instructions, expected answer format and opening text are identical, because only then can one reuse another's cache.

functions.name: refutedReask
functions.summary: Builds a re-ask about a review row the challenge step refuted.
functions.change: Now marks a split right after the long session text every re-ask repeats, so later re-asks for that stretch of session read it from cache. The text is unchanged.

functions.name: sharedCheckLines
functions.summary: Lists the opening lines that every code check of one change shares.
functions.change: Adds one definition of that shared opening: the person's instructions, a heading and the change itself. The three check builders now all use it.

functions.name: cutAfter
functions.summary: Gives the split point right after the shared opening lines.
functions.change: Adds where to split: the length of the shared opening lines joined together, plus one for the line break that ends them.

functions.name: buildVerifyRequest
functions.summary: Builds the request that asks an agent to check one finding.
functions.change: Now splits the request after the shared opening (instructions and the change), so checks of other findings on that change read it from cache. Wording is unchanged.

functions.name: buildBatchVerifyRequest
functions.summary: Builds the one request that checks all the review's questions.
functions.change: Now splits after the same opening as a finding check, so its own re-ask reads it from cache. Its different instructions keep it from sharing the finding checks' cache.

functions.name: buildAccountRequest
functions.summary: Builds an agent request that accounts for a batch of items.
functions.change: Now splits after the person's instructions and the change, which every accounting batch of that change shares, so batches after the first read that opening from cache.

functions.name: receiptRepairOnce
functions.summary: Asks once to fix candidates whose quoted evidence failed the check.
functions.change: The repair request now keeps the original's split points plus one where the original ended, so the original text it repeats is read from cache. Text is unchanged.

functions.name: verifyFinding
functions.summary: Checks one finding with an agent; re-asks once if unusable.
functions.change: Its one follow-up now keeps the original's split points plus one at the original's end, so the repeated original is read from cache instead of paid for again.

functions.name: verifyBatch
functions.summary: Checks the review's questions in one batch, re-asking once about unusable entries.
functions.change: As with a single finding's check: its follow-up now keeps the original's split points plus one where the original ended, so the repeated text comes from cache.

functions.name: accountBatch
functions.summary: Runs one accounting batch, re-asking once about entries it could not use.
functions.change: Its one follow-up now keeps the original's split points plus one where the original ended, so the original text it repeats is read from cache.

functions.name: runCodePass
functions.summary: Runs the code step: review agents, finding checks and accounting.
functions.change: All agent requests now pass through one queue: checks sharing an opening wait for the first's reply, and requests behind them wait too. Repairs extending the original reuse its cache.

functions.name: restatedRequirements
functions.summary: Re-asks the reviewer about each requirement the challenge step refuted.
functions.change: Its re-asks no longer go all at once: the first goes now, the rest once its reply begins, so they read the shared session text from cache.

functions.name: recolumnedDecisions
functions.summary: Re-asks about decisions the challenge step refuted on who made them.
functions.change: Same change as the requirement re-asks: the first goes at once, the rest wait for its reply, then read the shared session text from cache. No test drives this wait.

functions.name: reanchoredChoices
functions.summary: Re-asks for the agent's own words behind refuted choices not to act.
functions.change: Same change as the requirement re-asks: the first goes at once, the rest wait for its reply, then read the shared session text from cache. No test drives this wait.

functions.name: reviewCliArgs
functions.summary: Builds the command-line arguments for a plain Claude CLI call.
functions.change: A request sent in pieces now also switches the CLI to structured input (one JSON message on standard input), as images already did. Other requests' arguments are unchanged.

functions.name: reviewAgentCliArgs
functions.summary: Builds the command-line arguments for a Claude CLI agent that reads code.
functions.change: A request sent in pieces now switches the agent to structured input, so the CLI reads its prompt as one JSON message with separate pieces. Others are unchanged.

functions.name: imageContent
functions.summary: Builds a message's content: the prompt's text blocks, then any images.
functions.change: The prompt can now go as several text blocks, one per piece, only the first marked 'save up to here in the cache'. Without split points, still one block.

functions.name: claudeStreamInput
functions.summary: Writes the single JSON message line sent to the CLI's input.
functions.change: Now also used for requests sent in pieces, not only for requests with images, so the pieces and their cache mark reach the CLI.

functions.name: reviewTransportArguments
functions.summary: Returns each backend's call arguments, which the stored-answer key includes.
functions.change: Now passes 'sent in pieces' through, but only to the Claude CLI's arguments. Other backends never send pieces, so their arguments and stored-answer keys stay the same.

functions.name: callLocal
functions.summary: Runs one Claude CLI call: sends the prompt and reads the reply.
functions.change: Pieces now reach the CLI as separate text blocks. Agent calls now also signal 'reply started' at their first reply line, so requests waiting on them go sooner.

functions.name: withTransportRetry
functions.summary: Retries a failed call once; resends a refused split request whole, once.
functions.change: New safety net: if the provider rejects a split request as invalid, it is resent once as one piece, same text, so the added cache mark never fails a call.

functions.name: withoutParts
functions.summary: Copies a request without its split points, noting why they were dropped.
functions.change: Adds the copy used for that resend: same text in one piece, still able to signal 'reply started', and tagged with the reason so its attempt record says why.

functions.name: markResentWhole
functions.summary: Marks an answer as one that came from a whole resend.
functions.change: Adds a private list that remembers which answers came from a resend, so later code can tell, without changing any byte of the answer itself.

functions.name: resentWhole
functions.summary: Says whether an answer came from a whole resend.
functions.change: Adds the check the answer store uses to refuse such answers: the split request their stored key would describe did not produce them.

functions.name: createReviewJudge
functions.summary: Creates the function that makes each model call and records its details.
functions.change: An attempt resent as one piece now records why ('refused in parts'), so the review's usage record can count those resends.

functions.name: answerKey
functions.summary: Computes the key under which a model answer is stored and found.
functions.change: A split request's key now includes the CLI's structured-input setting, not the split positions, so its old stored answer no longer matches. Every other key is unchanged.

functions.name: agentAnswerKey
functions.summary: Computes the stored-answer key for an agent request.
functions.change: As with the plain key: a split agent request's key now includes the structured-input setting, so it never reuses an answer stored for the unsplit form.

functions.name: createAnswerCache
functions.summary: Creates the on-disk store of past model answers.
functions.change: Its save step now refuses answers got by a whole resend, since their key would claim the split request produced them. The next review simply asks again.

functions.name: memoizeJudge
functions.summary: Returns a stored answer when one exists, instead of a new call.
functions.change: When it reuses a stored answer, it now tells the waiting queue no call was made, so the next request sharing that opening takes the lead and writes the cache.

functions.name: createReviewBudget
functions.summary: Tracks a review's calls, limits and usage record.
functions.change: The usage record now counts calls sent in pieces and calls resent whole, by reason. A review with neither keeps its record exactly as before.

functions.name: runSessionReviewHarness
functions.summary: Runs one session review for assessments, stopping on serious provider errors.
functions.change: Its emergency stop no longer fires when a split request is rejected as invalid, because the transport resends it whole; the resend's own result still counts. No test covers this.
